How a set gets made

Four steps, no long calls. Most sets are done inside a week.

Step 1

You send the app

A build or a link, plus screen recordings. Send anything else you have too: copy, brand assets, or a reference app you like the look of.

Step 2

We agree the direction

I map the screenshots and the headline on each one. If you already have an idea for the set, we talk it through first and build it your way.

Step 3

Draft, then your notes

You see the full set, not one teaser screenshot. Revisions are unlimited, so send notes as many times as it takes.

Step 4

Delivery

Every size exported and named, layered Photoshop files attached, and the final invoice settled. Upload and ship.
